speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Jaundice (Physiological or Pathological)

The suggestion of acute appendicitis is medically impossible for a newborn and must be disregarded as an error or misinformation. Since you are a newborn with jaundice, appendicitis cannot be the cause. I have already ordered a Total Serum Bilirubin and Blood Type/Coombs test to determine if this is physiological jaundice or something like hemolytic disease. Please wait for these results, as they will confirm the diagnosis.
